notice: Account and clinical services are currently unavailable on this public site. Please do not submit health records or payment information.

sections.title: Current information handling
sections.body: Account and clinical services are currently unavailable on this public site. Do not submit health records or payment information. Browsing public pages does not establish that retained service integrations are active.

sections.title: Before personal data can be processed
sections.body: An operating organization must publish its identity and verified privacy contact, purposes and lawful bases, applicable health-data conditions, recipients and processors, transfer arrangements, retention schedule and rights procedures. Those operating details have not been verified for this release.

sections.title: Rights and retention
sections.body: Where GDPR applies, rights can include access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, subject to applicable conditions. Article 12 generally requires a response within one month; permitted extensions require timely explanation. Medical-record retention depends on applicable law and record type. HIPAA does not set a universal medical-record retention period.

sections.title: Current status
sections.body: Security, privacy and interoperability controls are under verification. This platform does not claim HIPAA or GDPR compliance, a SOC 2 examination, or FHIR conformance certification.

sections.title: Healthcare activation requirements
sections.body: Real-patient use requires a documented risk assessment, verified safeguards and access controls, applicable vendor agreements, staff responsibilities, incident response, backup recovery, retention operations and clinical review. Signed business associate agreements and designated privacy officers have not been verified.

sections.title: Standards and evidence
sections.body: FHIR defines healthcare information exchange; it does not replace authentication, authorization or secure transport. SOC 2 concerns examination of organizational controls. Source code and passing local tests alone do not establish either operational assurance or legal compliance.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: MediConnect provides public information about patient, clinician, staff and administrator workflows. Browsing this website does not create an appointment, activate a subscription or establish a clinical service commitment.

sections.title: Medical use
sections.body: The platform and its AI output are not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. For a medical emergency, contact your local emergency service. Do not rely on this platform for urgent care.

sections.title: Payments and future service terms
sections.body: Payment and clinical services are currently unavailable. Do not submit payment details or health records. Before these services are enabled, the operating organization must provide reviewed terms covering availability, eligibility, pricing, renewal, cancellation, refunds, privacy and applicable consumer rights. This notice does not replace those terms.
